products.name: DeepSeek
products.note: Open-weight MoE; cross-border data review advised

profile_text.body:
DeepSeek AI is a Chinese artificial intelligence research company founded in 2023 and headquartered in Hangzhou. The company describes its focus as researching foundational models and technologies for general artificial intelligence, and it open-sources its frontier large language models, including DeepSeek-V4, DeepSeek-R1, and the recently released DeepSeek-V4-Pro.

DeepSeek-V4-Pro is described on the company's site as a full release with significantly improved agent capabilities, support for Responses API and Codex integration, and availability across the web interface, mobile app, and API. The site also invites developers to access the models via API. The held facts classify DeepSeek as an open-weight mixture-of-experts product in the chat and general LLMs category, with a note that cross-border data review is advised for users.

No litigation, patent filings, SEC filings, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for DeepSeek AI.
